packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts.note: All named agent-loop test cases are ported, but source-wide integration and higher-level Agent behavior are separate coverage questions.

packages/agent/src/agent.ts.note: Native agent loop runs model requests and tools; full Agent API and extension integration remain incomplete.

packages/ai/src/api/anthropic-messages.t.note: Ported as three modules: anthropic-messages.bend (AnthropicOptions, getAnthropicCompat, cache control with PI_CACHE_RETENTION, Claude Code tool naming, transformMessages with tool-call id normalization, convertMessages with held-back system messages, consecutive tool results and the last-message cache marker, convertTools with strict JSON-schema tools, native tool changes with the deferred placeholder, getBetaFeatures with header overrides, managed-effort markers, buildParams, streamSimple's option mapping, mapStopReason, createClient's auth and headers; streamSimple's missing-auth error fails before a stream exists, as upstream throws synchronously); anthropic-messages-stream.bend (iterateSseMessages' line decoder with its trailing flush, iterateAnthropicEvents' filtering, repair and parse errors, the event loop with fallback pricing, input transformation diagnostics and the checks after the loop); anthropic-messages-client.bend (the stream lifecycle: injected or created client, onPayload replacement forcing streaming, retryProviderRequest over the shared Stainless request port, onResponse, start, the body loop and the catch block). tests/anthropic_messages_check.py compares 1,692 captured params and wire requests and 21 streamed messages and event sequences with pinned pi-mono, key order included, and runs the ported suites; tests/anthropic_client_loopback.py covers the HTTP path. Approved differences: X-Stainless-* platform headers are not sent (the SDK defaults come from the caller and are empty in the app); options.client is a callback returning status, headers and a body chunk source, and its failures are messages that are not retried; JSON.parse's engine-specific error text is replaced by the native parser's; a failing body read reports undici's "terminated"; event partials are snapshots; an unclosed block does not leak the scratch index field; diagnostic details go through a caller-supplied encoder (the app's details are Unit). No live Anthropic request has been verified.

packages/ai/src/api/bedrock-converse-str.note: Lazy loading of the implementation module through a dynamic import is a JavaScript bundling concern; the Bend runtime dispatches models of this api to bedrock-converse-stream.bend directly (coding-agent agent-runtime selectedProvider).

stream/streamSimple: the client configuration pi builds (profile, region from ARN/AWS_REGION/profile/built-in endpoint, custom endpoints, static credentials, bearer token), message/tool/system conversion with cache points and document sanitization, adaptive and budget thinking fields, onPayload/onResponse, the restJson ConverseStream request with SigV4 (runtime/aws-sigv4.bend) or bearer auth and caller headers minus reserved ones, the event-stream response (runtime/aws-eventstream.bend with CRC-32), the stream fold (text, reasoning incl. redacted, tool calls, usage with 1h cache writes, stop reasons) and error formatting with bedrock_response_failure diagnostics; traces equal the pinned AWS SDK on a loopback server (tests/bedrock_check.py). Missing: the SDK credential chain beyond shared-file static keys and credential_process (SSO, role assumption, web identity, ECS/IMDS; reported as errors, bedrock-credentials.bend), SDK retries, and HTTP(S) proxy agents. Unknown content-block types and lone surrogates are not representable in the typed Bend transcript.

packages/ai/src/api/cloudflare-ai-bindin.note: Not ported pending a decision: the module adapts a Cloudflare Workers AI binding (env.AI) into a fetch function plus the CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_BINDING_AUTH_SENTINEL header value, which only exist inside a Workers runtime; the native CLI has no binding to wrap. A structural port (an AiBinding value with an optional fetch callback and the sentinel) is possible but has no native caller.

packages/ai/src/api/google-generative-ai.note: Ported as three modules: google-generative-ai.bend (GoogleOptions, streamSimple's option mapping with clamped levels, level-or-budget thinking config and getGoogleBudget, buildParams producing the SDK parameters, client headers, and the SDK's parameter-to-REST conversion with its field order); google-generative-ai-stream.bend (the SDK's processStreamResponse framing with its delimiters, in-band error chunks and incomplete-segment error, and the chunk fold: text/thinking block transitions, signatures, function calls with generated ids, responseId, usage and finish reasons); google-generative-ai-client.bend (streamSimple's missing-key and level-mapping errors fail before a stream exists, as upstream throws synchronously; the stream lifecycle: custom-fetch (accepting the process fetch handle, globalThis.fetch upstream) and API-key checks, onPayload replacement, the SDK model path and address, headers, retryProviderRequest with status-only failures, the body loop and the catch block). tests/google_generative_ai_check.py compares 560 captured params, wire requests and streamed messages/event sequences with pinned pi-mono and runs the ported suites; tests/google_client_loopback.py covers the HTTP path and the agent glue. Documented differences (the tool-call counter one is flagged for review with the user): x-goog-api-client carries the SDK label without the gl-node/<process.version> runtime label (there is no Node runtime); the generated tool-call id counter is per stream instead of module-global (upstream's `let toolCallCounter` at google-generative-ai.ts:57; ids stay unique within a response and Date.now() distinguishes streams unless two start in the same millisecond); JSON.parse's engine-specific error text is replaced by the native parser's; event partials are snapshots. No live Gemini request has been verified.

packages/ai/src/api/google-shared.ts.note: Ported to google-shared.bend: Google thinking levels and their resolution/validation messages, usesGoogleThinkingLevel, disabled thinking config, thought-signature retention and validation, Gemini version rules (tool call ids, multimodal function responses, strict tool sampling), convertMessages (transformMessages with id normalization, signed/unsigned replay, empty-block handling, consecutive function responses, legacy image turns), sanitizeForOpenApi, convertTools with strict schemas, mapToolChoice, resolveGoogleFunctionCallingMode and mapStopReason/mapStopReasonString. Covered by the ported google-shared-* suites and the Google differential in tests/google_generative_ai_check.py. The Vertex caller is not ported, so Vertex-only paths are exercised only through the shared functions.

packages/ai/src/api/google-vertex.lazy.t.note: Lazy loading of the implementation module through a dynamic import is a JavaScript bundling concern; the Bend runtime dispatches models of this api to google-vertex.bend directly (coding-agent agent-runtime selectedProvider).

packages/ai/src/api/google-vertex.ts.note: stream/streamSimple: the custom-fetch check, resolveApiKey (ADC markers and placeholders), the API key or ADC client with project/location from options and env, buildHttpOptions (custom base URL at collection scope, version detection, User-Agent and header overlay), buildParams shared with Google Generative AI, onPayload, the SDK's Vertex URL, headers and request conversion, retryGoogleRequest, and the shared stream loop with the api name and 'Google Vertex stream ended without a finish reason'; streamSimple without a key requirement and with Vertex's 2.5 Flash-Lite budgets. packages/ai/src/api/mistral-conversation.note: Lazy loading of the implementation module through a dynamic import is a JavaScript bundling concern; the Bend runtime dispatches models of this api to mistral-conversations.bend directly (coding-agent agent-runtime selectedProvider).

stream/streamSimple: transcript resolution, Mistral tool-call id normalization, SDK-style payload and wire renaming, pi User-Agent and header overrides with x-affinity, the request timeout over the whole exchange, onPayload/onResponse, Mistral SSE framing, the chunk fold (text/thinking/tool calls, cached-token usage, stop reasons) and error formatting, all checked against upstream traces (tests/mistral_check.py). packages/ai/src/api/openai-completions.t.note: Request and stream sides ported. Request: ResolvedOpenAICompletionsCompat with detectCompat/getCompat; convertMessages (tool-call id normalization, thinking replay fields and reasoning_details, the four requires* flags, grammar tool calls, Kimi mid-conversation tools); convertTools with grammar custom tools; buildParams in upstream field order with every thinkingFormat, budgets, cache markers, routing and sampling overrides; createClient's headers including GitHub Copilot's dynamic headers. Stream: the chunk loop (text, thinking and tool-call blocks by wire index or id, custom grammar input, streamed reasoning_details, reasoning-field signatures with OpenCode Go's normalization, routed responseModel, parseChunkUsage), block endings and finish_reason checks with the supportsFinishReason: false fallback; the lifecycle over the shared SDK port (getClientApiKey, onPayload, retried request, onResponse, SDK SSE with in-chunk errors, abort as stopReason aborted, the catch block's message with OpenRouter metadata.raw appended as String(raw)). Byte-identical to upstream on the suites' named cases, native cases for Copilot headers, raw metadata kinds and mid-stream abort, 724 generated requests and 114 generated streams (tests/openai_completions_request_check.py, tests/openai_completions_stream_check.py).

packages/ai/src/api/openai-prompt-cache..note: clampOpenAIPromptCacheKey keeps 64 code points (surrogate pairs normalized first); exercised by the prompt-cache suite's clamping case through the Completions request.

packages/ai/src/api/openai-responses.ts.note: Native OpenAI/Codex request and stream path works; provider suites remain partial and some upstream request/header behavior differs. packages/ai/src/api/openrouter-images.ts.note: generateImages: the missing-key error, buildParams (sanitized text parts, data-URL image parts, stream false, modalities from the model's outputs), the OpenAI SDK client over openai-client.bend (bearer auth, model then option headers with nulls dropped, the request timeout), onPayload replacement, retryProviderRequest around one SDK attempt, onResponse after the body is read, responseId, parseUsage with cache reads/writes and per-million pricing, the first choice's text and data-URL images, and error/aborted results with the formatted provider error; tests/openrouter_images_check.py compares 14 cases with upstream images.ts driving the pinned OpenAI SDK. packages/ai/src/api/pi-messages.lazy.ts.note: Lazy loading of the implementation module through a dynamic import is a JavaScript bundling concern; the Bend runtime dispatches models of this api to pi-messages.bend directly (coding-agent agent-runtime selectedProvider).

packages/ai/src/api/pi-messages.ts.note: stream/streamSimple, payload, headers, onPayload/onResponse, SSE framing, event conversion, rewrite and response-failure diagnostics and createErrorEvent are ported and checked against upstream traces (tests/pi_messages_check.py). Native adaptations: streamSimple takes debug as an argument (upstream reads it from a cast options object); unknown event types are skipped rather than forwarded; content blocks placed past the end are appended instead of making a sparse array; malformed JSON/events and transport failures report native messages; fetch runs under a deadline scope that never expires (the maximum U32 milliseconds), as upstream passes only the caller's signal.

packages/ai/src/auth/credential-store.ts.note: The injectable CredentialStore interface and persistent auth.json store exist, but the public default InMemoryCredentialStore and its per-provider serialized modify/delete behavior do not.

packages/ai/src/auth/helpers.ts.note: Standard API-key providers prompt through ProviderAuthInteraction with a SecretPrompt and resolve stored credentials before environment variables. Empty keys are rejected. Cloudflare auth regressions validate the migrated shared prompt contract on Bun/native1/native4. The lazy OAuth helper remains absent.

packages/ai/src/auth/oauth/anthropic.ts.note: Native OAuthAuth.login uses PKCE, the upstream authorization URL, callback host override, browser/manual arbitration, progress notification and authorization-code exchange. Refresh retains the five-minute expiry margin and toAuth derives bearer auth. Native callback/manual fixtures check state rejection, cancellation, typed prompt failures and occupied-port fallback; the PKCE oracle checks generated challenges. Callback completion HTML is simplified; exact token-error classification/rendering and source-wide edge-case parity remain incomplete.

packages/ai/src/auth/oauth/openai-codex..note: Native OAuthAuth.login selects browser/device login. Browser authorization uses PKCE, independent 16-byte hex state, upstream URL fields, callback host override, state validation, manual-input fallback and token exchange with the browser redirect URI. Device login notifies the user code then polls/exchanges with the device redirect URI. Refresh and toAuth remain native. Browser/manual workers share typed first-settlement arbitration and are cancelled/joined before disposal. Callback completion HTML is simplified; exact token-error classification/rendering and source-wide edge-case parity remain incomplete.

packages/ai/src/auth/oauth/pkce.ts.note: Native generatePKCE reads 32 secure random bytes, base64url-encodes the verifier and SHA-256 challenge, and returns immutable PKCE fields. Failures are typed errors. tests/anthropic_oauth_start_check.py compares native one/four-thread authorization challenges with the Python SHA-256/base64 oracle; browser interaction tests exercise worker cleanup.

packages/ai/src/auth/types.ts.note: Credential storage and provider auth resolution have native types. AuthPrompt covers text, secret, selection and manual code with optional per-prompt cancellation; AuthEvent covers info/links, authorization URLs, device codes and progress. AuthInteraction accepts an optional signal; ProviderAuthInteraction carries a required signal. OAuthAuth.login is required, and both API-key and OAuth callbacks use prompt/notify interactions. ApiKeyAuth.check and the remaining auth-context contract are incomplete.

packages/ai/src/bedrock-provider.ts.note: A package entry point that re-exports stream/streamSimple so Bun-compiled binaries can preload the Bedrock module (coding-agent bun/runtime-setup.ts); Bend modules import api/bedrock-converse-stream.bend directly.

packages/ai/src/image-models.generated.t.note: Generated from the pinned image-models.generated.ts by scripts/generate-model-catalog.py --images; tests/openrouter_images_check.py compares all 55 models with it.

packages/ai/src/image-models.ts.note: getImageModel, getImageProviders and getImageModels over the generated catalog; an unknown provider or id has no model (upstream returns undefined).

packages/ai/src/images-models.ts.note: ImagesProvider/createImagesProvider (name defaulting to the id, last-known catalog, refreshModels with in-flight sharing: a call that waited for a concurrent refresh shares its outcome), and ImagesModels: set/delete/clear providers as value transitions (replacement keeps the position), getProviders/getProvider/getModels/getModel, refresh with model_source failures for one provider and best-effort concurrent refresh of all, getAuth through resolveProviderAuth, and generateImages with auth resolution and per-field option merging (unknown providers and auth rejections become error results). packages/ai/src/images.ts.note: generateImages through the registered api provider; a missing provider is a failure with upstream's message. The registry is passed in instead of being filled by importing register-builtins.

Provider, RefreshModelsContext and ModelsPublication have native representations and fetched-catalog helpers. The standalone Models/MutableModels collection is not exposed in pi-ai: much of its catalog, auth, refresh and request behavior currently lives in coding-agent ModelRuntime/agent-runtime. packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts.note: anthropicApiKeyAuth is ported (stored key, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN as a Bearer Authorization header, ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; the login prompt is the shared env api-key login, which additionally rejects an empty key), with the catalog and the caller-created OAuth auth. packages/ai/src/providers/cloudflare-aut.note: Workers AI and AI Gateway resolve per-field stored and ambient values; native login prompts for key, account ID and optional gateway ID. Focused Bend tests exercise both login credential shapes and the existing resolver cases; broader model-runtime integration remains partial.

packages/ai/src/providers/images/registe.note: registerBuiltInImagesApiProviders registers the openrouter-images api into a registry value; the caller supplies the api callback. The lazy-load failure result has no counterpart because nothing is loaded lazily.

packages/ai/src/providers/mistral.models.note: Generated from pi-ai's mistral.json by scripts/generate-model-catalog.py; tests/model-catalog.bend dumps all 33 models equal to the pinned data.

packages/ai/src/providers/mistral.ts.note: The Mistral provider with its MISTRAL_API_KEY auth, base URL and catalog, listed in providers/all.bend in upstream order.

packages/ai/src/providers/opencode-heade.note: withSessionHeader for stream options and withSimpleSessionHeader for streamSimple options: a nonempty sessionId adds x-opencode-session after the caller's headers unless a caller header (even a null removal) already names it case-insensitively. The provider wrapper withOpenCodeSessionHeader is Models.OpenCodeStreams{apis} (the APIs each OpenCode provider wraps, as in opencode.ts/opencode-go.ts); agent-runtime applies Models.streamSimpleOptions after prepareRequest, as upstream's wrapper sees the merged request headers. models.json overlays inherit the wrapper for their base models' APIs (supportsBaseApi). Covered by packages/ai/test/opencode-provider-headers.bend.

packages/ai/src/providers/openrouter-ima.note: The OpenRouter images provider with OPENROUTER_API_KEY auth and the generated catalog, registered by builtinImagesModels (providers/all.bend). Missing: the lazy OpenRouter OAuth, as for the chat provider.

packages/ai/src/utils/uuid.ts.note: uuidv7 keeps upstream's process-wide monotonic sequence (seeded once from 40 random bits, 2^41-1 exhaustion), clamps ordinary clock rollback, preserves follower timestamps and rejects timestamps outside integers 0..2^48-1. The module state is an explicit State with a pure transition; a Generator owns it in a Ref. Bend has no module globals, so the process generator is created once by main (or by --export) and reaches session creation through the session value, AgentSession summaries and the session picker. Entropy failure is a Bend-only error result.

packages/coding-agent/src/cli/initial-me.note: buildInitialMessage: stdin content (when present), non-empty @file text and the first CLI message join into the initial prompt; the remaining messages are returned instead of shifted off parsed.messages. main.bend passes its result to print and interactive startup. tests/initial-message.bend ports initial-message.test.ts.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-ses.note: Native sessions run, and extension context binding, commands and provider refresh are now present; v0.87.1 compaction cancellation (de2de549b) is ported except the summarization-auth abort signal; prompt images and tool-result images are normalized with the image setting and the current model's resize profile (f5c946480). sendCustomMessage (nextTurn, steer/followUp while streaming, deferral to turn_end without triggerTurn, triggerTurn runs) and sendUserMessage (expandPromptTemplates) are ported with the pending custom-message flushes at turn_end, run settlement and prompt, and bound as the extension runtime's sendMessage/sendUserMessage actions. Extension events: agent/turn_start/message/tool_execution events reach extensions before listeners, message_end replacements are persisted and projected, tool_call and tool_result run in the agent's tool hooks, agent_settled precedes the public event; navigateTree runs session_before_tree (cancel, supplied summary, instruction and label overrides) under the branch-summary controller and emits session_tree; manual and automatic compaction run session_before_compact (cancel or supplied result), then session_compact or session_compact_failed; waitForIdle waits for session-level idleness (no run, compaction or branch summary). turn_end boundaries run from the agent's finishTurn (or the turn_end event for synthesized failures) and agent_before_settle before settlement, with drafts previewed, committed and announced after the context refresh; post-run handling continues for queued messages only after retry and compaction (no queue drain before retry). Missing: session_start/switch/fork/shutdown extension events, context, before_agent_start, input, user_bash, _isEmittingAgentSettled deferral, and replaced messages inside turn_end/agent_end payloads. The skill-block parser used by restored transcripts is in core/skills.bend.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/auth-guid.note: All four messages; callers pass the docs directory where upstream reads its package location (config.ts getDocsPath). Not yet used by AgentSession.prompt's preflight (see tests/rpc.md).

packages/coding-agent/src/core/export-ht.note: Native session snapshot and browser assets are ported. Interactive HTML export uses the active resolved theme, including missing-configured-theme fallback, with light/dark palette checks. Custom tool HTML rendering and standalone/RPC theme parity remain unverified.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/extension.note: Inline factories load into a runtime (loadExtensionFromFactory/loadExtensionFactories) with registerCommand, registerProvider/unregisterProvider (deferred while loading), on/unsubscribe, sendMessage and sendUserMessage (failing before the session binds them with upstream's not-initialized message). No file discovery or jiti loading (JS extensions are excluded; extensions are compiled Bend). Missing: registerTool/Shortcut/Flag/renderers, appendEntry, session name/label, active tools, model and thinking actions, events bus.

Native ExtensionRunner: bindCore/bindCommandContext/setUIContext, command resolution with invocation names, error listeners, snapshotEventHandlers, emit for events without results, emitMessageEnd (same-role replacement chain), emitToolCall (first block wins, failures propagate), emitToolResult (patched fields), and the session_before_tree/session_before_compact results of emit (last result, cancel stops dispatch, failures reported). emitBoundary (turn_end/agent_before_settle: drafts and continuation carried between handlers, a preview rebuilt after each, invalid drafts reported). Missing: session_before_switch/fork, emitContext, emitBeforeAgentStart, emitInput, emitUserBash, provider request/header events, emitCacheWarmingDecision, emitResourcesDiscover, shortcuts, flags, renderers, tool registrations, invalidate/stale contexts.

Typed native events and results for agent_start/end/settled, turn_start, message_start/update/end, tool_execution_*, tool_call, tool_result, session_before_tree/session_tree (TreePreparation, summary and instruction overrides), session_before_compact/session_compact/session_compact_failed, turn_end/agent_before_settle boundaries (SessionBoundaryDraft, BoundaryContextPreview, BoundaryResult, AgentActivityOutcome), commands, InlineExtension, ExtensionError and the sendMessage/sendUserMessage actions. tool_call input is one JSON value, not upstream's per-tool narrowed variants; compaction details are the typed read/modified file lists. Missing: session_start/switch/fork/shutdown/info events, context/context_with_system, before_agent_start, input, user_bash, model/thinking select, provider request/response, UI prompt events, tools/shortcuts/flags/renderer registration types.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/model-run.note: Reviewed login path: native login dispatches by provider and auth type, normalizes an absent signal with an owned controller, rejects pre-aborted requests, saves through the credential store and refreshes availability. Interactive API-key login uses this path; OAuth providers implement native login callbacks. Upstream per-provider credential-operation serialization, complete synchronizeCredentialState behavior and source-wide ModelRuntime coverage remain incomplete.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-m.note: Session persistence, resume, tree and fork work; complete upstream session/recovery parity is not claimed.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-.note: collectSettingsDiagnostics drains the manager's load errors into warnings with the file path, or the scope when storage has none, and returns the drained manager; deduplicateDiagnostics keeps the first of each type and message. AgentSessionRuntimeDiagnostic (agent-session-services.ts) lives here with `type` renamed `kind`. Error messages are the port's typed settings errors rendered as text. main.bend reports startup settings diagnostics through them. tests/settings-diagnostics.bend ports settings-diagnostics.test.ts.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/bas.note: Native Bash execution and interactive streaming work; the tool now reads live session context, while output preview and exact terminal parity retain known gaps.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/edi.note: Native edit execution works; complete upstream edit behavior is not established by the current source review.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/pat.note: Tool path expansion and resolution live in utils/paths.bend, and read-file fallback candidates live there too; the upstream path-utils test suite is still pending.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/pow.note: The Windows PowerShell tool, UTF-8 setup and public tool factory are absent; the native tool registry has no powershell entry.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/rea.note: Native text and image reading with live model context are wired: the non-vision note and the context model's image resize profile (else the tool's own resizeOptions, v0.87.1) reach native image processing. Background image-worker scheduling and full upstream behavior remain open.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/ren.note: Width-aware five-visual-line tail previews, skipped-line counts and ordinary bash snapshots match upstream; the broader renderer contract is not yet fully validated.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/wri.note: Native write execution works; complete upstream source contract has not been reviewed.

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interact.note: The fullscreen transcript scrolls independently of the dock and matches page/wheel parity. Pending/status/widget dock sections and configurable scrollbar settings remain open.

Assistant text/thinking rendering, stream updates, independent thinking-run clicks, global reset, mouse hit regions, output padding and stop errors are ported. Markdown extension transformers and their streaming/width context remain incomplete.
Collapsed/expanded Markdown rendering, theme and mouse toggle are present; broader terminal-frame parity remains unverified.
Collapsed/expanded Markdown rendering, token count, theme and mouse toggle are present; broader terminal-frame parity remains unverified.

Native timer rounds positive durations up to seconds, calls the initial tick, decrements every second, expires once and cancels/joins on disposal. Retry tick/disposal is exercised by the status suite. Zero duration completes immediately at zero instead of emitting a negative tick a second later; independent expiry/optional-redraw callback tests remain unported.
Displayed text messages use the default themed Markdown box and hidden messages are omitted. Extension-supplied custom renderers and output-pad changes are not yet ported.

Native footer renders session/model/thinking, usage, context and status data. Auto-compaction state is refreshed from the live session on render and its enabled marker matches the settings-toggle terminal scenario. Full source-wide callback, subscription and extension-status parity remains unverified. Run/retry/compaction lifecycle events preserve extension status data; their indicators render in the editor border.

Provider login uses native AuthPrompt/AuthEvent and shared TUI Input. Selection returns the option ID directly and restores preceding dialog content. Text, secret and manual-code prompts preserve notifications; authorization URLs and messages wrap with the TUI ANSI wrapper while retaining their full hyperlink targets. Submission keeps immutable displayed content and masks secrets while returning their raw value. Per-prompt cancellation races removable observations, joins its watchers and leaves the parent signal active. Input and browser-interaction fixtures exercise editing, notifications, selection, browser/manual arbitration and cancellation. Full mouse behavior and completion-page/UI parity remain unreviewed.

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/json.note: serializeJsonLine and the LF-only framing step of attachJsonlLineReader over decoded text; byte-compared with upstream in tests/rpc_protocol_check.py. Stream attachment and UTF-8 decoding belong to the callers (main.bend's stdin loop, RpcClient's stdout reader).

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-.note: RpcClient with every command method, start/stop of the child (SIGTERM, SIGKILL after 1 s), request ids, 30 s request timeouts, exit/spawn/stdin failures rejecting pending requests, strict JSONL stdout with StringDecoder-style UTF-8, stderr collection/forwarding, event listeners, waitForIdle/collectEvents/promptAndWait and getData. Adaptations: cliPath is the agent executable (not `node cliPath`); the transport is the injectable `send` (withSend); results are typed, decoded per command; events are their JSON values (json-event's JsonAgentSessionEvent); a spawn failure fails start() instead of the later send; requests still pending at stop() fail with the exit error instead of their timeouts; listeners run on the stdout reader and must not wait for responses or unsubscribe themselves.

All commands, JSONL framing, correlated errors, prompt/queue semantics, session replacement through the host, event streaming, and extension UI (select/confirm/input dialogs answered by extension_ui_response, notify/setStatus, extension_error records) in rpc mode. Gaps: the prompt response precedes AgentSession's preflight (no preflightResult), so preflight failures are acknowledged as success; commands other than prompts run on the input reader, so an extension dialog opened from one would block; editor/setWidget/setTitle/set_editor_text and dialog timeouts are absent from the native UI context; command-context actions and the shutdown handler are not bound; stdout backpressure and signal handling belong to main.bend. See tests/rpc.md.

Typed RpcCommand (encoder), response envelope, RpcSessionState, RpcSlashCommand, RpcExtensionUIRequest and RpcExtensionUIResponse, with encoders used by the endpoint and decoders used by RpcClient and the endpoint's extension UI, plus wire codecs for bash results, cleared queues and the entry tree. Per-command response data stays JSON in the envelope and is decoded by each client method.
